title: Polynomial Learner Work Bound
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, every subset $P$ of the $n$ coordinates, and all $k,b\in\mathbb{N}$, set $\ell=k-\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$ and $T_0=1$, $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$. Define $C=2^\ell(\ell+1+\lceil\log_2T_k\rceil+2(\lfloor3k/4\rfloor+1)+5)$, $D=\binom{r}{\le\ell}$ where $r$ is the number of coordinates outside $P$, and $m$ to be the polynomial sample count at failure parameter $2^{-(b+1)}/T_k$. Then the work bound $m(D+1)+Dm(D+2)+D(D+1)$ is at most $\bigl(C(\ell+2)+(\ell+1)C(\ell+3)+(\ell+1)(\ell+2)\bigr)(n+1)^{3\ell}(b+1)$. Here $\binom{r}{\le\ell}$ denotes the number of subsets of an $r$-element set of size at most $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
